_about: What a short or ambiguous English string means on screen, for whoever translates it — the draft model and the human reviewer alike. Keyed by the English exactly as it appears in the message files. A note is worth writing whenever the English alone could be read two ways.
Graduated: Launch phase: the sale sold out and the token's pool opened. pump.fun's sense — the token 'graduated' to a live market — never the school sense.
Refunded: Launch phase: the sale missed its target and every minter's XCP was returned automatically.
Scheduled: Launch phase: announced on-chain, minting has not opened yet.
Minting: Launch phase: open now; people are paying XCP for tokens.
Upcoming: Chip on a scheduled launch's card.
Minted out: The sale reached its cap; no more can be minted.
Reached: Stat label on a refunded launch: how far the sale got toward its target, as a percentage.
Raised: Stat label: XCP paid in so far, or in total.
Target: Stat label: the XCP the sale needs to reach to succeed.
Paid: Column header in a mint list: XCP that minter paid.
Side: Order-book column header: whether a row is a buy or a sell.
Lots: Column header: how many 1,000-token lots a mint bought.
Data: Stat label in the price modal: which market the number comes from and how fresh it is.
Market: Trade panel tab: a market order against the pool, as opposed to a limit order.
Max: Button: fill the amount field with the most the wallet can spend or mint.
Total: Column header: total XCP for the row.
Expires: Column header: when a resting limit order expires.
Deadline: Stat label: the block by which a minting launch must reach its target.
Failed on: Stat label on a refunded launch: the date it failed.
Sold out in: Stat label on a graduated launch: how long the sale took to sell out.
Closed: Launch status: the sale is over, one way or the other.
closing: Sort option: launches whose minting window ends soonest.
Announced: Table header: when the launch was announced on-chain.
All: Filter chip in search: every phase. Also the chart range meaning the whole history.
All@@window: Return window label on a card, beside 24H: the launch's whole life since mint.
All-time: Table column header: return since the mint price, over the launch's whole life.
since mint: Suffix after a return percentage: measured from the price minters paid.
Fills now: Limit-order preview: the part of the order that executes immediately against the book.
Min received: Swap preview: the least you will receive after slippage.
You pay: Mint/swap panel row: what leaves your wallet.
You mint: Mint panel row: the tokens you receive.
Per address: Stat label: the maximum one address may mint.
In pool: Stat label: tokens sitting in the AMM pool.
Liquidity: Stat label: XCP in the AMM pool.
Holders: Stat label and tab: addresses holding the token. The community says ホルダー.
Trading Data: Link to opreturn.art, a third-party analytics site.
Dispense: Nav label: the page for buying XCP from Counterparty dispensers with BTC.
Limit: Nav label: the limit-order (order book) trading page.
Swap: Nav label: the AMM swap page.
Activity: Nav label: the site-wide feed of recent mints and trades.
XCP Rewards: The programme that pays minters XCP; a proper noun on this site.
Wearing the crown: Tooltip on the card pinned first in the Minting section: it minted most recently.
Who was here: Tooltip title on the presence badge: how many people have the site open.
Hero headline shown only before the first launch ever exists.
Launch the first: Hero button before the first launch exists.
book: The order book, as one word inside a sentence like 'from the pool and the book'.
pool: The AMM pool, as one word inside a sentence.
spread: Order book: the gap between best bid and best ask.
within 1%: Pool depth: what the pool absorbs before its price moves 1%.
vs pool: Order book: how a resting order's price compares with the pool's.
{n}× apart: Order book: the best bid and ask are this many times apart.
adjusts to {n}: Mint panel: the amount will be rounded to the nearest whole lot.
at ATH: Price is at its all-time high right now.
closes@@chart: Price chart caption: closing prices, the series a line chart draws ("Hourly closes"). A noun.
Mempool@@chip: The amber header chip "Mempool (2)": a count of unconfirmed XCP-69 transactions waiting for a block. Translate the meaning (unconfirmed / pending), not the jargon; a Japanese reviewer read メンプール as main pool. Keep it to about 5em: it sits in the header row beside the nav, and a long one clips the nav in languages whose words are already long.
limit: Tab on a launch page beside swap and liquidity: the limit-order mode. Lowercase; the tab capitalises it in CSS.
swap: Tab beside liquidity: the swap mode. Lowercase; the tab capitalises it in CSS.
liquidity: Tab beside swap: add or remove pool liquidity. Lowercase; the tab capitalises it in CSS.
Filled: An order status: the whole order executed. Not "full".
inscription: Chip on a launch whose image is inscribed on-chain, linking to the ordinals record. Lowercase, inside a pill beside an arrow.
Dismiss: Accessible name for the × that closes an error banner.
